name: recon-findings
query_sql: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE source_worker='reconnaissance-engine' AND status='active' ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: critical-vulns
query_sql: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE severity='critical' AND status='active' ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: high-vulns
query_sql: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE severity='high' AND status='active' ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: exploitable-findings
query_sql: SELECT d.* FROM documents d JOIN document_links dl ON d.uuid=dl.target_uuid WHERE dl.link_type='confirms' AND d.status='active'

name: code-audit-findings
query_sql: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE source_worker='code-config-auditor' AND status='active' ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: cve-intel
query_sql: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE category='cve' OR category='intel' ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: poc-library
query_sql: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE category='poc' AND status='active' ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: active-playbooks
query_sql: SELECT * FROM playbooks WHERE status='approved' ORDER BY category, name

name: mitre-mapped
query_sql: SELECT d.*, mt.technique_id, mt.tactic FROM documents d JOIN mitre_techniques mt ON d.uuid=mt.document_uuid WHERE d.status='active'
description: All findings mapped to MITRE ATT&CK

name: by-target-domain
query_sql: SELECT d.*, e.entity_value as domain FROM documents d JOIN entities e ON d.uuid=e.document_uuid WHERE e.entity_type='domain' AND e.entity_value LIKE ? AND d.status='active'
description: Findings for a specific domain (param: domain pattern)
